name: West Valley College Concurrent Enrollment
what_you_do: Students in grades 9 to 12 take West Valley College classes for free. Middle College and on-campus dual enrollment exist for some districts.
who_can_apply: Concurrent enrollment: grades 9 to 12, with approval from your high school. Middle College: juniors and seniors from LGSUHSD and CUHSD. Dual enrollment on high school campuses: CUHSD (Campbell Union High School District) students only.
pay_detail: No registration fees or tuition at a participating California high school. You pay class fees, books and supplies.
deadline_text: For winter and spring 2027, the college application is open and the Concurrent Enrollment Form opens Nov 2, 2026. Registration starts Nov 16, 2026 for the classes of 2027 to 2030. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Talk to your counselor first. Apply to the college. Then send the Concurrent Enrollment Form with your counselor form. Register on or after your date. The college's Concurrent Enrollment page lists all the steps.
notes: You can take up to 8 units per semester. Ask your counselor about credit.
